title: DownloadIntent
description: Short-lived, rights-bound authorization to fetch one exact artifact payload. Composes with ArtifactEnvelope identity: the intent commits to the exact payload_sha256 and delivery re-verifies the bytes against that commitment before serving. The intent id is NOT a bearer token — delivery re-resolves request identity and re-checks principal binding, owner scope, expiry, and revocation on every fetch. Revocation stops all future deliveries; every content delivery is admitted to the intent's owner-scoped stream BEFORE bytes are served, so the audit trail cannot claim less than what was delivered. Expiry is derived from expires_at_ms at read time, never stored as a status.

artifact_kind.description: The artifact family this intent delivers from. Extensible only by an owner ruling in evidence-and-delivery.md — an unlisted kind is refused at mint, not interpreted.

artifact_ref.description: The exact owning resource the payload belongs to, e.g. backup://...

payload_sha256.description: Exact bytes commitment. Delivery re-hashes the payload against this before serving; a mismatch is a typed conflict, never a silent substitution.

principal_ref.description: The principal the intent is bound to. Delivery refuses any other authenticated principal.

owner_ref.description: The owning org:// or project:// scope the intent was admitted under.

scope_kind.description: The admission scope kind that authorized minting — the same scope the underlying artifact family enforces.

resource_ref.description: The resource that scope was checked against.

expires_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds. Delivery compares against the live clock; expiry is never stored as a status because a stored status goes stale.

status.description: Lifecycle. Revocation stops future deliveries; it never rewrites the admitted delivery history.

supports_ranges.description: HTTP Range / resume posture. Ranges serve from the same hash-verified payload; a completed range grants nothing about the whole.

delivery_admissions.description: Count of admitted content deliveries. Admitted BEFORE bytes are served.

created_at.description: Projection of the admitted mint transition's own timestamp — never the wall clock.

updated_at.description: Projection of the latest admitted transition's timestamp.

admitted_head.description: Head of the intent's owner-scoped admission stream, projected for CAS on successors.
